propositions: Retiring MCP container holds a blue-green port for ~1200s even with zero in-flight certified ops, because uvicorn timeout_graceful_shutdown is coupled to the full grace_seconds budget, starving the two-port pool and causing port-exhausted deploy failures under high redeploy cadence

New certified ops arriving during MCP graceful shutdown drain can re-increment the in-flight gauge and re-pin the retiring port for the full grace window, preventing the gauge from reaching zero and allowing a burst to extend the shutdown indefinitely

Review bot redeploy fails open without drain check when /health is unreachable, unable to distinguish a bot mid-redeploy (transient) from a bot genuinely wedged (persistent), causing blind recreation and review interrupt signals
Retiring MCP container with >0 in-flight certified ops must receive the full grace_seconds drain and never be cut short by uvicorn's graceful shutdown timeout
An unreadable /health endpoint caused by mid-redeploy bot should defer the drain gate with a countable marker rather than triggering a blind fail-open recreate

Decoupling uvicorn graceful shutdown timeout from the certified-op drain budget and explicitly refusing new intake during drain allows retiring containers to fast-drain when in-flight gauge reaches zero while preserving full drain time for real in-flight operations
